events.address: North Esplanade by The Rink, 45 Rockefeller Plaza, New York, NY 10111
events.what_it_is: A two-day NYFW activation for Sally Hansen's Miracle Gel Bold Glam collection with nail touch-ups, photo moments and hands-on shade discovery at Rockefeller Center.
events.what_is_free: Public access to the activation is free. Nail touch-ups and photo moments are advertised; specific product samples or giveaways are not promised to every attendee.
events.caveats: Rockefeller Center confirms the dates, hours and North Esplanade location. NYC Plugged explicitly lists the activation as open to the public. Capacity and on-site service availability can still vary.
events.practical_notes: Saturday, September 12 from 12–6 PM and Sunday, September 13 from 10 AM–6 PM at the North Esplanade by The Rink. No advance RSVP requirement is published.

events.what_it_is: A two-day Calzedonia NYFW pop-up with hair and beauty refresh stations, a photo booth, hosiery customization, coffee and branded stickers.
events.what_is_free: Public entry, coffee, branded stickers, hairstyle touch-ups and the photo booth are advertised as free. Embroidery is free only with purchase of eligible 20 Denier Hosiery Knee Highs.
events.caveats: Two current NYC event sources agree that the pop-up is open to the public. Embroidery is purchase-dependent, and samples or refreshments may be limited by on-site inventory.
events.practical_notes: September 12 and 13 from 12–5 PM at 188 Lafayette Street. No advance RSVP or approval requirement is published in the verified listings.

events.event_name: Beauty Break with Urban Outfitters and Yes Day
events.address: Urban Outfitters, 1333 Broadway, New York, NY 10018
events.what_it_is: A three-hour Urban Outfitters and Yes Day beauty activation with an aura photo booth, Dirty Soda Bar, bouquet bar and on-site customization.
events.what_is_free: The aura photo booth, Dirty Soda Bar, bouquet bar and other listed activations are advertised as free while supplies last. Customization requires a Yes Day purchase.
events.caveats: The Eventbrite listing is organized by Urban Outfitters and confirms the date, time and address. Average Socialite advertises a free RSVP. The sources do not state that RSVP approval is required or that a reservation guarantees entry. Free activations are while supplies last; customization requires purchase.
events.practical_notes: Saturday, September 12 from 12–3 PM at Urban Outfitters, 1333 Broadway. A free Eventbrite RSVP is available; treat it as optional because the verified sources do not explicitly state that registration is mandatory for store entry.

events.event_name: Scoop the City Ice Cream Truck Tour
events.address: Multiple NYC stops; see dated occurrence details
events.what_it_is: A two-day mobile ice-cream truck tour from Piece of Cake Moving and StreetEasy highlighting NYC neighborhoods from their 2026 neighborhood data.
events.what_is_free: Free ice cream treats are offered at the scheduled truck stops. Visitors can also enter giveaways for Knicks tickets, restaurant gift cards, MTA passes, merchandise and other prizes; giveaway wins are not guaranteed.
events.caveats: This is a moving truck with short neighborhood windows rather than one fixed venue. Free treats and giveaway inventory can run out. The official event page says to follow @pieceofcakemoving for exact live locations if the truck route changes.
